proposal.observation: ZN-E022 S1 (18,657 params ≈ 18 KB INT8): MAPE 0.3526 (+0.020 vs ZN-E010), Acc@15 0.2275 (-0.139), RMSE 444.9, gradient HEALTHY. The internal-flash budget allows ~28 KB of INT8 weights, so S1 leaves ~10 KB unused.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: Using the full ~28 KB INT8 budget (stem 20/40, d_model 40, 1 residual block, fade_hidden 40; 28,921 params, +55% capacity over S1) recovers part of the lost accuracy: split-2021 MAPE <= 0.3525 and Acc@15 >= 0.3365.
proposal.question_inherited: How much accuracy does the Zn-ion model lose when shrunk to fit the 64 KB internal flash?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: The accuracy-size trade-off of the frozen architecture family below 30 K parameters.
proposal.why_this_experiment: Phase-3 compression follow-up (Gemini ZN-E022 analysis): largest model of this family that still fits the internal-flash weight budget; no KD (needs user approval, phase3_targets.md M5).
proposal.modification: Width only vs ZN-E022: stem 16/32 -> 20/40, d_model 32 -> 40, fade_hidden 32 -> 40 (1 residual block kept). Training identical.
proposal.held_constant_components: Architecture family (ResConv curve encoder + anchored fade encoder + masked summary + linear GELU head), GELU, objective, optimizer, data, split, seed, epoch rule.
proposal.controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, split 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE vs ZN-E010 and ZN-E022; params (28,921 ≈ 28.2 KB INT8); gradient gate; 3-split confirmation and INT8/board check if kept.
proposal.rejection_condition: Phase-3 compression rule: KEEP (deployable compressed candidate) iff split-2021 MAPE <= 0.3525 AND Acc@15 >= 0.3365 AND gradient gate PASS AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; then confirm on splits 42/2024 (3-split mean MAPE <= 0.352). Otherwise DISCARD and report as a size-accuracy trade-off point.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; cycle_stem, residual_blocks, fade_encoder, inter_summary and head gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput.

architecture_addendum.evidence: 64 KB internal-flash budget; INT8 of the full E fails accuracy
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> ResConv [B,100,64] (h_t) -> u_t=[h_t, h_t-h_1] [B,100,128] -> Linear 128->64, GELU, Linear 64->64, +h_t -> g_t [B,100,64] * mask -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> GELU -> Linear [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: h_1 = cycle index 0 (always observed); g_t multiplied by mask; mean over mask==1, last at mask.sum()-1, delta last - first. tests/test_anchored_fade.py: padding invariance and cycle-1 dependence.
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15, DB-MAPE (= MAPE) vs ZN-E005; EOL bands; gradient gate incl. fade_encoder

proposal.smoke_evidence: Same code path as ZN-E022 (Kaggle T4 full run) and ZN-E022S; only widths change.
